turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyText:
Standard domestic and international orders can take up to **4 business days** to process before they ship and tracking starts updating.

If you already have a tracking number but it looks like nothing is happening yet, the first carrier scan can take a couple of days after the label is created. For shipping timeframes by method, see [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyText:

- **2 Business Days (order by 3pm ET):** $21.99  
- **1 Business Day (order by 3pm ET):** $25.99  

Business days don’t include weekends or US holidays. Full details are on our [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options) page.

Not after checkout, shipping speed can’t be changed once an order is placed.

If you haven’t ordered yet (or you place a new order), you can pick an expedited option at checkout if it’s available for your address, like **1 Business Day** or **2 Business Days**.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyText:
If tracking never updates, it usually means either the carrier hasn’t done the first scan yet (that can take a couple of days after a label is created) or the order is still processing.

If it’s past the delivery estimate and tracking still hasn’t moved, contact us and we can investigate. You can also check status anytime on the [Track Order page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/track-order).
